article.story: TEMPE, Ariz. -- — Paulius Murauskas scored 23 points, including two clutch free throws with 13 seconds left, and Arizona State rallied from a 14-point second-half deficit to defeat Oakland 68-65 on Wednesday night. Oakland led 28-26 at halftime then increased the lead to 47-33 eight minutes into the second half. The Sun Devils' rally included runs of 9-2 and 9-0 and they regained the lead at 57-55 on a dunk by Jonathan Griman with 4:40 remaining. Ryder Bradley's 3-pointer gave the Golden Grizzlies their final lead at 60-59 near the two-minute mark. A 3-pointer from Murauskas put the Sun Devils ahead for good, but a 3 from Nassim Mashhour drew Oakland within 66-65 with 31 seconds remaining. Murauskas, who made 13 of 13 free throws, hit his last two to make it 68-65 and Bradley's 3-point try was off the mark with six seconds left. Dillan Shaw had 12 points and 12 rebounds for the Sun Devils (5-0). Joel Foxwell scored 11 and Ben Defty had 10 points. Murauskas added eight rebounds and four assists. Bradley led Oakland (1-6) with 20 points and Chris Fields Jr. had 17 points and 11 rebounds. Mashhour scored 15 points. Up next Oakland: The Golden Grizzlies play at Purdue on Friday. Arizona State: The Sun Devils play LSU in the Acrisure Series on Wednesday. -------- Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here.
